title: Journey of a River
introduction: ‘Journey of a River’ is treated as an inquiry-based learning unit. The chapter connects river source and flow, tributaries, landscapes along a river, people depending on rivers, floods and pollution. Learners observe the situation, identify evidence, explain relationships, consider consequences and apply the learning to a new context without reproducing textbook wording.
